evidence.text: PE32+ PyInstaller/Python3.13; entry aes_client invokes secure_comm.client.main; functionality implemented in Cython pyd.
Client imports include PyRun_StringFlags and PyEval_EvalCode. Strings include _recv_loop and exec: arg 1 must be string, bytes or code object. No call/data-flow connecting these has been recovered.
IDA session_create failed seven times: Input file not found / HTTP 500. Pyd instruction-level semantics not verified. No runtime evidence.
Fourteen selected Windows high-risk APIs had zero import hits. No hardcoded external IP, persistence, process injection or credential theft strings found. Bootloader appears standard.
Docstrings describe AES secure communication and DH handshake; peer suggests legitimate educational tool. This is a peer interpretation, not verified authorization evidence.

historical_assessment.dataflow: No independent malicious logic in bootloader or Python layer.
